About us

Every company has a mission. What's ours? To empower every person and every organization to achieve more. We believe technology can and should be a force for good and that meaningful innovation contributes to a brighter world in the future and today. Our culture doesn’t just encourage curiosity; it embraces it. Each day we make progress together by showing up as our authentic selves. We show up with a learn-it-all mentality. We show up cheering on others, knowing their success doesn't diminish our own. We show up every day open to learning our own biases, changing our behavior, and inviting in differences. Because impact matters. Microsoft operates in 190 countries and is made up of approximately 228,000 passionate employees worldwide.

    Economic opportunity isn't just about creating more jobs; it’s about making the path to those jobs easier to navigate. Microsoft’s Chief Economic Opportunity Officer and Head of the Frontier Mindset Lab, Aneesh Raman uses a simple analogy: think of economic opportunity as a house. But instead of waiting to be invited in, you let yourself in. It's a different way to think about how AI can help expand access to opportunity, from individual workers to entire workforces and the next generation of entrepreneurs.

    Please join us at Microsoft Ignite, our biggest customer and partner event of the year, from November 17-20 in San Francisco. Last year, we shared a vision for Frontier Transformation as a wholesale reinvention of business by leading with human ambition and focusing on outcomes first. We explained that the two most important elements of any AI solution are intelligence and trust. Since then, we have become more emboldened by these convictions, and have hardened a platform approach across Copilot, Microsoft IQ, and Agent 365. This year, we will unveil our latest innovations, with our customers and partners joining us on stage to share examples of how these platforms have composed to put AI to work in meaningful ways, enabling pragmatic paths to become Frontier. We believe their stories will inspire you like they have inspired all of us at Microsoft and help you to imagine what is possible for your organization.
